name: Tandil
shape: geoBoundaries, the department it is named for

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

blurb.text: An Argentine geographical indication in Buenos Aires province, with only a few hectares of vines.
